result.title: SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Long-horizon agentic RL is constrained by the futures visited by the current policy. When rollouts fail to reach useful behaviors, improved credit assignment cannot provide supervision for states and actions that were never encountered. On-policy distillation (OPD) introduces teacher guidance on policy-induced states, and recent multi-turn variants improve how this guidance is scheduled, replayed, refined, or validated. However, they do not directly use the oracle-controlled future itself as the training trajectory. We introduce \textbf{State-Rooted Executable Rollout Optimization (SERO)}, which augments on-policy agentic RL with executable oracle continuations. SERO restores a state actually reached by the current policy and lets a training-only oracle continue interacting with the real environment, making the downstream observations and oracle actions themselves available for learning. It then applies \textbf{policy-reachability weighting}, which weights each oracle step by the frozen behavior policy's compatibility with the preceding oracle actions. This allows deeper supervision to become effective as the policy becomes more compatible with the oracle branch. The oracle loss is optimized separately from the base RL estimator and no oracle is used at inference time. We evaluate SERO on two challenging interactive-agent benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. On ALFWorld, learning the full executable continuation is substantially more effective than supervising only the root oracle action, while policy-reachability weighting further improves out-of-distribution performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SERO，在长程 agentic RL 中从当前策略实际到达的状态出发，用仅训练期可用的 oracle 与环境继续交互，把后续观测与 oracle 动作作为监督，并按冻结行为策略对前置 oracle 动作的兼容性做可达性加权，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用 oracle 延续扩展策略未访问轨迹」与按行为策略兼容性加权监督的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 分支或轨迹监督的权重设计与离策略状态复用；但工作为纯文本智能体 RL，与视觉 latent 推理联系需进一步判断，暂列为方法线索。
